6.323 rsInvalidColumnsInReportSection
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidColumnsInReportSection is a critical error that will occur when a Page.Columns element
within a ReportSection is set to a number that is less than 1 or greater than 1000.
